concerns.text: FR-007 mandates a fallback mechanism: generate N=5 candidate images per prompt and select the best via SSIM against reference geometry. Task T022 is marked `[~] FAILED: unspecified` and T022b is marked `[~]` (incomplete). No active task exists to implement the N=5 generation loop or the SSIM selection logic, leaving a critical spec requirement unimplemented.

FR-007 requires identical random seeds for Baseline and Experimental groups. Tasks T019 and T019b (implementing seed locking) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). Without these tasks, the system cannot satisfy the spec's requirement to isolate the prompt variable via seed locking.

FR-006 and Edge Cases require logging 'Generation Failure' after 3 retries. Task T020 (retry logic and logging) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The pipeline cannot handle generation failures as mandated.

FR-006 requires logging contradictory scenes as 'Invalid Physics Rules'. Tasks T014 (validation logic) and T015 (error handling) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The system cannot detect or log contradictions, violating FR-006.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan require pinned seeds and model paths. Task T007 (Environment configuration) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). No artifact exists to enforce these settings.

Plan.md defines a specific Project Structure (code/simulation, code/generation, etc.). Tasks T001g through T001q (creating these directories) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The foundational structure required by the Plan does not exist.

FR-001/US-1 requires a curated set of 500 (or N=100 per Plan) scene descriptions inferable for physics. Task T011 mentions fetching from COCO but lacks a specific task to filter for 'physics-inferable' scenes or verify the curated set, risking violation of the 'Data Hygiene' principle if non-physical scenes are included.
